local function CannonDamage(NPC)
    local backpack = game.Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local cannon = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Hand Cannon")
    if cannon then
        local args = {
            [1] = cannon,
            [2] = NPC
        }
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.GunHit:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end
end

local function SimulateAttack()
    local char = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
    local sword = char and char:FindFirstChild("Sword")
    if sword then
        local args = {
            [1] = sword,
            [2] = 1
        }
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.MeleeAttacked:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end
end

GunModsTab:CreateSection("Player Gun Modifications")

local gunSettingsFolder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Modules", 5) 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules:WaitForChild("Tools", 5) 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tools:WaitForChild("Gun", 5) 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tools.Gun:WaitForChild("Settings", 5)

local OriginalGunSettings = {}

if gunSettingsFolder then
    local ExcludedModules = {
        "Minigun", "Suppressor Minigun", "Golden Minigun", "Weedwhacker",
        "Melee", "Armor", "Throwable", "Item"
    }

    local function isGunScript(moduleScript)
        if not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then return false end
        if table.find(ExcludedModules, moduleScript.Name) then return false end
        
        local success, settings = pcall(require, moduleScript)
        if success and typeof(settings) == "table" then
            return settings.AmmoPerMag ~= nil or settings.FireRate ~= nil or settings.ProjectileObject ~= nil
        end
        return false
    end

    for _, v in pairs(gunSettingsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if isGunScript(v) then
            local success, settings = pcall(require, v)
            if success and settings then
                OriginalGunSettings[v.Name] = {
                    AmmoPerMag = settings.AmmoPerMag,
                    FireRate = settings.FireRate,
                    Automatic = settings.Automatic,
                    Spread = settings.Spread,
                    MaxPierce = settings.MaxPierce,
                    ProjectilesPerShot = settings.ProjectilesPerShot or 1,
                    ProjectileSpeed = settings.ProjectileSpeed or 100,
                    ReloadTime = settings.ReloadTime,
                    WindUp = settings.WindUp,
                    HeadshotDamageMultiplier = settings.HeadshotDamageMultiplier,
                    EquipTime = settings.EquipTime,
                    WalkSpeedMultiplier = settings.WalkSpeedMultiplier or 1,
                    CrossExpansion = settings.CrossExpansion,
                    PumpTime = settings.PumpTime,
                    ShotgunPreReloadTime = settings.ShotgunPreReloadTime,
                    ShotgunClipinTime = settings.ShotgunClipinTime
                }
            end
        end
    end
end

local CustomBulletsAmount = 30
local CustomHeadshotMultiplier = 50
local CustomFireRateValue = 0.05
local CustomBulletsEnabled = false
local HeadshotBuffEnabled = false
local CustomFireRateEnabled = false

local function applyGunMod(gunName, modifierFunc)
    if not gunSettingsFolder then return end
    local mod = gunSettingsFolder:FindFirstChild(gunName)
    if mod then
        local success, a = pcall(require, mod)
        local orig = OriginalGunSettings[gunName]
        if success and a and orig then
            modifierFunc(a, orig)
        end
    end
end

GunModsTab:CreateToggle({

MeleeModsTab:CreateSection("Melee & Ability Modifications")

local meleeSettingsFolder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Modules") 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules:FindFirstChild("Tools") 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tools:FindFirstChild("Melee") 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tools.Melee:FindFirstChild("Settings")

local OriginalMeleeSettings = {}

if meleeSettingsFolder then
    for _, moduleScript in pairs(meleeSettingsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local success, settings = pcall(require, moduleScript)
            if success and typeof(settings) == "table" then
                OriginalMeleeSettings[moduleScript.Name] = {
                    EquipTime = settings.EquipTime,
                    WalkSpeedMultiplier = settings.WalkSpeedMultiplier,
                    MeleeParryHealthRegenAmount = settings.MeleeParryHealthRegenAmount,
                    Attacks = {}
                }
                if settings.Attacks then
                    for k, atk in pairs(settings.Attacks) do
                        OriginalMeleeSettings[moduleScript.Name].Attacks[k] = {
                            Cooldown = atk.Cooldown,
                            Knockback = atk.Knockback,
                            ParryStart = atk.ParryStart,
                            ParryTime = atk.ParryTime
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

MeleeModsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Zero Melee Attack Cooldown",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "ZeroMeleeCooldown",
   Callback = function(Value)
      if not meleeSettingsFolder then return end
      for _, mod in pairs(meleeSettingsFolder:GetChildren()) do
          if mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
              local success, a = pcall(require, mod)
              local orig = OriginalMeleeSettings[mod.Name]
              if success and a and a.Attacks then
                  for k, atk in pairs(a.Attacks) do
                      if Value then
                          atk.Cooldown = 0
                      elseif orig and orig.Attacks[k] then
                          atk.Cooldown = orig.Attacks[k].Cooldown
                      end
                  end
              end
          end
      end
   end,
})

MeleeModsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Instant Equip Melee",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "MeleeInstaEquip",
   Callback = function(Value)
      if not meleeSettingsFolder then return end

          if mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
              local success, a = pcall(require, mod)
              local orig = OriginalMeleeSettings[mod.Name]
              if success and a then
                  a.EquipTime = Value and 0 or (orig and orig.EquipTime or a.EquipTime)
              end
          end

})

scripts.title: HITBOX ALL
scripts.script:
-- PLEASE BEFORE USING THE SCRIPT
-- IT MAKES THE ENEMIES FLOAT IN THE SKY, PLEASE LOOK UP!
--TRY TO FARM FOR A GUN BEFORE EXECUTING THE SCRIPT SO YOU CAN SHOOT THEM UP

local enemyNames = {
    "Robloxian",
    "Angry Robloxian",
    "Giant Robloxian",
    "Tiny Robloxian",
    "Orc",
    "Goblin"
}

local function resizeTorso(part, scale)
    part.Size = part.Size * scale
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.Transparency = 0.5 -- put how transparent is the torso
end

-- if you want to stop the modification from running click L (on keyboard)
local function resetTorso(part, originalSize, originalTransparency)
    part.Size = originalSize
    part.CanCollide = true
    part.CanQuery = true
    part.CanTouch = true
    part.Transparency = originalTransparency
end

local originalProperties = {}

-- loop to auto check for enemies
local running = true
while running do
    for _, enemyName in ipairs(enemyNames) do
        for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if instance:IsA("Model") and instance.Name == enemyName then
                local torso = instance:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                if torso and not originalProperties[torso] then
                    -- restore original torso size
                    originalProperties[torso] = { Size = torso.Size, Transparency = torso.Transparency }
                    -- resize torso
                    resizeTorso(torso, 15)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    wait(0.1) -- it checks every 0.1 seconds ig
end

--key press detection
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        running = false
        -- revert torso to normal
        for torso, properties in pairs(originalProperties) do
            resetTorso(torso, properties.Size, properties.Transparency)
        end
    end
end)
